decisions.reason: As a schlager compilation CD it is very close to the firm's existing curation, label, and physical-release capabilities, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is well placed to learn from early sales and improve rather than withdraw it quickly.

Because the illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's established offer and already appears as a multi-model line, management is likely to see enough related knowledge and scope for refinement to keep it on the market.
